feedback.answered: The fixed trusted run produced a complete violating cycle comparison: after transfer abort, identical protocol/storage state recurs across ten fair tick/drain iterations while AutoLeave remains true. review_items.rationale:
Applicability and normative meaning: C-auto-exit-continuation v1 addresses the library-owned continuation of an already committed/applied JointImplicit configuration. S-joint-contract and S-joint-duty explicitly assign exit to Raft; S-auto implements an internal zero-change proposal after application completion. S-proposal rejects that proposal during transfer. These sources, together with the normal caller contract, support continued automatic exit after temporary obstruction, without a new unrelated user proposal. There is no numeric exit deadline. The checked proposition is absence of a closed fair execution cycle retaining the admitted automatic configuration, not a finite-time service guarantee or consensus-safety violation.

Fixed prefix and caller legality: inspected the fixed assurance_generated_test.go and plan for artifact d04a65b3ea2947d1bf6d0e4a856f24d9, with original claim/binding versions 1. The three instances start from identical index-1/term-1 snapshots, HardState commit=1 and Applied=1, as permitted by RawNode bootstrap recommendations; no inconsistent synthetic peer messages or private state writes are used. Public Campaign elects node 1 in term 2 through actual vote messages. Public ProposeConfChange commits removal of 3 under the old voter configuration. At leader delivery of that committed entry, TransferLeader(2) precedes ApplyConfChange and Advance, a legal serialized overlap also permitted by the Node loop servicing messages/configuration while a Ready is outstanding. Each Ready is persisted before its messages enter the transport, and configuration application precedes Advance. All network delivery is FIFO with one preselected type-specific loss policy. Actual TimeoutNow(1->2,term=2) was dropped once; no local storage response was dropped. All three nodes continue ticking in the formal suffix, including outgoing voter 3.

Actual observations: CheckRun 1f6dcf3ed0e64684805c07f201f458ba completed with no parsing errors. Admission identifies op_id=implicit-remove-3, node=1, change_index=3, entry_term=term=2, AutoLeave=true, StateLeader and target=2. After application/Advance the log endpoints are 3 and all pending work is drained. cycle_start at tick 10 has target=0, same term/leader and no Ready/messages. cycle_result at tick 20 has identical 7357-character raw state, AutoLeave=true and outgoing_count=3. Independently comparing the retained start and end strings reproduces cycle_repeats=true. Captured MemoryStorage contents on all nodes retain the same snapshot, HardState and actual entries, including term-2 index-3 ConfChangeV2 bytes; this is content equality rather than merely index equality.

State and scheduling correspondence: read-only reflection includes every RawNode field, raft state and timer/config fields, tracker vote/progress/inflight state, read queues, log application accounting, unstable entries/snapshot state, MemoryStorage log/HardState/snapshot, network queue and schedule phase. The observations occur on the sole owner goroutine after drain; no mutable cache, asynchronous application, unfinished Ready or external callback is sampled. Fields skipped by exact name are logger/traceLogger, duplicated raftLog.storage, MemoryStorage.Mutex and callStats. The concrete MemoryStorage object is captured separately. Call statistics only increment and do not control target behavior; the mutex has no concurrent user. The default trace build is checked and its hooks are no-ops. Function code identities are captured, bound receiver identities remain fixed, and allocation addresses are irrelevant along this suffix: no log replacement or pointer-dependent branch occurs. Slice capacities and nil/empty distinctions are retained. Driver tick/drop/trace counters are diagnostics, not policy inputs. Their omission cannot activate a hidden continuation.

Closed suffix rather than elapsed waiting: the retained delivery trace contains exactly ten copies of four messages: term-2 heartbeat 1->2 at commit 3, heartbeat 1->3 at commit 3, and the corresponding heartbeat replies 2->1 and 3->1. No other message type appears. Tracker.Visit sorts IDs. Each fixed iteration ticks 1,2,3 then drains every Ready and FIFO message. Followers reach electionElapsed=1 before a same-term heartbeat resets it to zero; their captured randomized election timeouts are 11 and 13. No election, reset, snapshot or application event can arise in this suffix; the global election RNG is therefore never consumed. Leader electionElapsed cycles modulo 10, CheckQuorum observes both responsive voters, heartbeatElapsed resets each tick, and the recorded recent-active/progress state returns exactly. No append is sent because Match=last=3 and peers are in replicate state. No pending read context creates further work. Thus repeating the same fair schedule from the same behavior state repeats this suffix and cannot propose or apply joint exit. This is a source-supported repeatability argument over an executed cycle, not an inference from forty elapsed ticks.

Oracle and correlation: admission_alias is admitted; start depends on admitted.term and is correlated by op_id/node/change_index, followed by a separate cycle_result with the same stable operation identity. Neither the state string nor AutoLeave is used to correlate identity. The monitor independently selects the fixed transport policy. It checks cycle_repeats=true implies auto_leave=false; state equality is an antecedent rather than an applicability filter, and the observed antecedent is true. If state had differed, a holds result would only exclude this particular cycle witness. The actual AutoLeave=true result completes the violating implication. No requirement was weakened and no expected state or observed result was precomputed.

Cause and contrary mechanisms: at application completion S-auto reaches its leader/AutoLeave/index guard but Step rejects because leadTransferee=2; S-abort later only clears that field. S-advance creates an application response only for committed entries, so processing empty heartbeat Readys cannot retrigger appliedTo. A later entry or newly elected leader can restart exit, and the existing leadership-loss test exercises that different continuation. The prior exploration also observed control success and rescue by an extra proposal, but that output remains construction knowledge and is not reused as formal Evidence. The present fixed run directly demonstrates the narrower lost-continuation history. Retained outgoing quorum requirements and blocked subsequent non-exit configuration proposals are sourced potential consequences; no external client outage or safety failure was measured.

Explained alternatives and limits: Later committed-entry application can retry exit; leadership change can append a new-term entry and thereby trigger it. These are conditional recovery paths outside required work in the observed closed suffix. Joint quorum remains operational: all three replicas hold the configuration entry and both follower heartbeat streams succeed. This is not loss of consensus safety or loss of quorum.
review_items.report_title: 领导权转移失败后，自动退出联合配置的续行丢失
review_items.report_answer: 正式执行中，隐式联合配置在转移期间应用；转移于第 10 个 tick 结束，但第 10 与第 20 个 tick 的协议、存储与队列状态完全相同，AutoLeave 仍为 true。两个跟随者均响应了全部心跳；结合已核对的执行路径，该闭合循环表明自动退出依赖新的应用事件，不能仅靠正常驱动恢复。此结论不声称数值超时违约或已观测到客户端停机。
limitations: One synchronous RawNode/MemoryStorage history with default no-op tracing and serial transport; async storage, alternative schedules and other changes are not tested.
The closed-cycle inference depends on the explicitly reviewed state projection and source-determined suffix; it is not an unbounded wall-clock execution or a numeric-deadline claim.
No client endpoint availability or data-loss consequence is measured. The formal finding concerns automatic configuration-exit continuation.
